preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMaxTxPercent(0) to set _maxTxAmount to zero. This will cause all transfers from non-owner addresses to fail because the _transfer function checks if amount <= _maxTxAmount when sender != owner() && recipient != owner(). This effectively stops all user transactions while allowing the owner to continue transferring tokens.
